Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 42  
Reason for Mistake:  
The first clear error was when WebSurfer claimed that the GoldDerby page “provides a comprehensive gallery featuring every winner” and then effectively summarized the page without extracting any birthdates. That was a false completion of the needed task: the user needed the winner born in May, which required specific birthdate data, not a generic description of the page. This misled the orchestration into repeatedly relying on the same source without obtaining the key information, contributing directly to the wrong final answer.
